name: ServerViewableItems
description: A collection of objects that have been marked as viewable on the server.
remarks: This is a collection of references to objects in the workbook. Only objects in this collection will be shown on the server. By default, the entire workbook (including all worksheets) is shown. Only one ServerViewableItems object can exist per workbook. This collection is not indexable by name because there is no guarantee that the names of objects that are marked as viewable on the server are unique. In the Excel user interface, you can view the collection of objects that are marked as viewable on the server in the Excel Services Options dialog box.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the collection. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a reference to the ServerViewableItems collection.

parameters.name: Obj
parameters.description: The reference to an object. The object can be a reference to sheets or named items (for example, named ranges, charts, tables, and PivotTables). You cannot have both sheets and named items in the same collection.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a reference to an object in the ServerViewableItems collection in the workbook.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index of the object that you want to delete.

methods.name: DeleteAll
methods.description: Deletes references to all the objects in the ServerViewableItems collection in the workbook.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single object from the ServerViewableItems collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index of the object to be returned.
